name: Biophage Jaeger
source:
In Biophage Jaeger, you follow the story of Alice or Otto, a recently grafted Biophage struggling to take care of their younger sister. After a strange hunt, they are pulled into a rabbit hole that puts both themselves and their sister in grave danger.

But you do not play as Alice or Otto.

Rather, you play as their Parasite, Weiss, with your decisions influencing Alice and Otto toward one path or another. You are the passenger in their mind, the voice whispering into their ear, the thing that will either help them escape the rabbit hole or drag them even deeper into it.

[From [url=https://studiohexttrpg.itch.io/biophage-jaeger]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《噬生猎兵》中，故事围绕爱丽丝或奥托展开——作为一名刚完成移植改造不久的“噬生体”，主角正艰难地照料着年幼的妹妹。然而一次蹊跷的狩猎行动将主角卷入了一个无底深渊，令兄妹（或姐妹）二人双双陷入灭顶之灾。

但你扮演的并不是爱丽丝或奥托。

相反，你将扮演寄宿于主角体内的寄生体“怀斯”，通过你的抉择引导爱丽丝或奥托走向截然不同的道路。你是潜伏在他们意识中的乘客，是在他们耳畔低语的声音——既能助他们逃出深渊，也能将他们拖入万劫不复的谷底。

[摘自[url=https://studiohexttrpg.itch.io/biophage-jaeger]itch.io[/url]]
